title: Computational Biology Research Group
text: We are a research group focused on computational biology and bioinformatics in the School of Microbiology at the Universidad de Antioquia. Our work aims to understand microbial communities, antimicrobial resistance, and host-pathogen interactions through the lens of metagenomics, single-cell and genomic analysis.

title: Computational Biology Research Group
text: We are a research group focused on computational biology and bioinformatics in the School of Microbiology at the Universidad de Antioquia. Our work aims to understand microbial communities, antimicrobial resistance, and host-pathogen interactions through the lens of metagenomics, single-cell and genomic analysis.

title: Computational Biology Research Group
text:
Research Areas

Metagenomics and resistome analysis — characterization of antimicrobial resistance genes in environmental and clinical samples.
Genomics and molecular epidemiology — genomic, evolutionary, and epidemiological characterization of bacterial pathogens.
Host-pathogen interactions — using model organisms to study bacteria-host dynamics.
